LegacyTelemetryEvent carries the event twice on the wire: a zigzag type and a varuint ordinal. The oracle selects the body by type and re-derives the ordinal on encode (writer.go EventOrdinal); the generated union selects by the ordinal tag. Well-formed traffic always agrees on both — the oracle itself derives one from the other — so a different body is only selectable with fuzzed input whose type and ordinal disagree.
